Dear 

It seems that there is a problem in running the sunTime function since the new year given that overlap is no longer exists on CRAN -- someone who had similar problems ? how to adapt the following script lines ? Solutions ? 

rec_table$clo<-gettime(rec_table$DateTimeOriginal)
rec_table$sunt<-  sunTime(rec_table$clo,rec_table$DateTimeOriginal,coords)

Hi Jim,
I will take over as maintainer after Mike Meredith passed away and another volunteer maintainer didn't act (hence it was archived on CRAN) The updated version is on GitHub and should work.

https://github.com/EcoDynIZW/overlap/
  
Install via:
remotes::install_github("EcoDynIZW/overlap")

It is also submitted to CRAN, should hopefully be up soon.
Best regards,
Jürgen
